import sys
import itertools

n = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())

A_vals = list(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().strip().split()))
B_vals = list(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().strip().split()))

A_orig = A_vals[:]
B_orig = B_vals[:]

def max_win(A_list, B_list):
    total = 0
    for i in range(3):
        opponent_idx = (i + 1) % 3
        wins = min(A_list[i], B_list[opponent_idx])
        A_list[i] -= wins
        B_list[opponent_idx] -= wins
        total += wins
    return total

def max_loss(A_list, B_list):
    move_pairs = [[0, 2], [1, 0], [2, 1], [0, 0], [1, 1], [2, 2]]
    all_permutations = list(itertools.permutations(move_pairs))
    max_loss_value = 0
    for perm in all_permutations:
        A_copy = A_list[:]
        B_copy = B_list[:]
        losses = [0, 0, 0]
        for move in perm:
            loss_amount = min(A_copy[move[0]], B_copy[move[1]])
            A_copy[move[0]] -= loss_amount
            B_copy[move[1]] -= loss_amount
            losses[move[0]] += loss_amount
        total_loss = sum(losses)
        if total_loss > max_loss_value:
            max_loss_value = total_loss
    return max_loss_value

print(n - max_loss(A_orig, B_orig), max_win(A_vals, B_vals))
